review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: D4 base, G3, G4, topology guide, protected-composite report, and full comparison were independently inspected.
review_views.notes: Narrow protection restores more relief beside roads, but the six-landform hierarchy remains unreadable.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The 1536x1024 G4 final was inspected at native scale.
review_views.notes: Both main fields remain repeated bright-centered radial mounds; only one foothill is independently visible.

review_views.label: 200%・400%拡大
review_views.evidence: North-east and south-east relief fields were inspected at enlarged detail.
review_views.notes: The narrower mask improves raw support but does not turn three weak foothills into recognizable terrain.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: The full final and four border gates were scanned across nine regions.
review_views.notes: External geometry is exact; defects are confined to the declared relief vocabulary.

review_views.label: 制御図との半透明重ね合わせ
review_views.evidence: All six controlled footprints and automated edit/protection evidence were compared.
review_views.notes: Raw support retention improves, while required two-rise saddles and four foothills still fail visually.

review_views.label: 親ズーム画像との比較
review_views.evidence: Candidate D v4 and G4 were compared at matching extent and reduced scale.
review_views.notes: Palette continues, but raised conical rosettes introduce an incompatible terrain grammar.

review_views.label: 四方向の隣接合成
review_views.evidence: Border, road-adjacent, and permission-boundary evidence was checked.
review_views.notes: The former broad road voids are substantially removed; only slight mechanical hachure stopping remains.

review_views.label: ベクターラベル・道路・POI重畳
review_views.evidence: Roads, city, coast, fields, forests, and protected detail were inspected.
review_views.notes: Canonical linework remains exact and more readable than G3.

review_views.label: Leafletデスクトップ表示
review_views.evidence: Desktop suitability was assessed from native and enlarged views without staging the rejected image.

review_views.label: Leafletモバイル表示
review_views.evidence: Mobile suitability was assessed from the reduced overview without staging the rejected image.
review_views.notes: Three foothills disappear and the two main fields read as repeated texture.

immediate_failures.label: 海岸線・河川・主要道路・城壁の移動
immediate_failures.evidence: All automated outside-permission, road-core, detail-core, zero-mask, and border gates report zero difference.

immediate_failures.label: 必須地点・地形の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: NE-west, SE-west, and SE-east do not read as independent foothills; both main massifs also lack a stable two-rise plus open-saddle reading.

immediate_failures.label: 正典外の主要都市・施設
immediate_failures.evidence: No noncanonical settlement, facility, route, or landmark was introduced.

immediate_failures.label: AI生成文字・記号
immediate_failures.evidence: No generated text, pseudo-label, legend, compass, signature, or route label was found.

immediate_failures.label: 目視できる継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: The 16px road core removes G3's broad flat channels; slight local stroke stopping is not a major seam.

immediate_failures.label: 現代物・透かし・署名
immediate_failures.evidence: No modern element, watermark, logo, or signature was found.

immediate_failures.label: 遠近法化・縮尺の急変
immediate_failures.evidence: Bright centers and convergent dark lines read as top-lit conical or volcanic rises rather than flat cartographic hachure.

immediate_failures.label: 建物・樹木・岩の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: At least fifteen bright-centered radial rosette or fingerprint forms repeat across both main fields.

scores.label: 正典・地形形状との一致
scores.notes: Protected canon is exact, but three foothills and both saddle hierarchies are missing.

scores.label: 親子ズームの連続性
scores.notes: Palette continues; radial pseudo-relief does not.

scores.label: 隣接画像の継ぎ目
scores.notes: Outer and road continuity improve substantially, with minor mechanical stopping.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: Historical color is compatible, while repeated bright-centered rosettes are not.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Main fields are over-articulated and secondary terrain is too weak.

scores.label: 生成破綻・反復模様
scores.notes: Repeated radial centers remain the dominant artifact.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Narrow protection improves road and detail continuity, but relief texture still competes.

summary: G4 is rejected. Narrow protection fixes G3's broad road voids and preserves canonical pixels exactly, but ImageGen's radial bright-centered terrain remains repetitive and three foothills plus the required saddle hierarchy are unreadable.
required_changes: Keep the validated narrow protection policy unchanged.
Replace only the generated relief vocabulary with compact, non-convergent, non-illuminated and individually distinct terrain marks for all six footprints.
